   - Failure Description: Wear, corrosion, or damage to the journal bearings
   - Occurrence Frequency: Medium

   - Failure Description: Leakage or damage to the shaft seals
   - Occurrence Frequency: Medium
   - Consequence: Loss of lubrication and increased friction, leading to severe damage to the rotor and stator components

   - Failure Description: Settlement, vibration, or corrosion in the foundation
